messages.subject: Quartz - option to tax (action needed before completion)
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

For the sale to proceed as a TOGC (no VAT on the £8.45m price), Thornbury must, before completion: be VAT-registered (you are), make an option to tax Quartz House and notify HMRC, and confirm to the seller the option won't be disapplied. If we miss this, VAT of £1.69m becomes payable. Can your team submit the option to tax this week?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
